caption: The Soviet Union didn't tell anyone about Chernobyl. Sweden found out from workers' SHOES 👟☢️ Would the world have known without them? 👇 #chernobyl #history #sweden #coldwar #historytok #dailydrop

scenes.title: Alarms at the *wrong* plant
scenes.say: On the morning of April twenty-eighth, nineteen eighty-six, radiation alarms went off at a nuclear plant in Sweden.
scenes.display: On the morning of April 28th, 1986, radiation alarms went off at a nuclear plant in Sweden.

scenes.say: Workers were setting off the radiation detectors. The radiation was on their shoes.

scenes.title: But their reactor was *fine.*
scenes.say: Engineers checked everything. Their own reactor wasn't leaking. The radiation had blown in on the wind, from more than a thousand kilometres away.

scenes.title: Chernobyl
scenes.say: The source was Chernobyl, in Soviet Ukraine, where Reactor Four had exploded two days earlier. The Soviet Union hadn't told the world.
Under pressure from Sweden, Soviet television read out a short statement that evening, admitting there had been an accident.

scenes.text: Would the world have known *without Sweden?*
scenes.say: Would the world have found out without Sweden? The full story is on our channel.
